name: chatgpt-local-bridge
description: Control the user's own Windows PC and allowed local development workspaces from normal ChatGPT requests.

interface.shortDescription: Act directly on this Windows PC from normal chat requests.
interface.longDescription: ChatGPT Local Bridge exposes bounded local Windows and workspace actions to ChatGPT Desktop. Ask naturally to open an app, inspect the screen, interact with a GUI, edit an allowed project, run tests or builds, or verify results. The assistant chooses the appropriate local tools automatically; users do not need to name tools.
defaultPrompt: Open Paint and draw what I ask for
Work on DoOnce and verify the change
Open an installed app on my PC
